owner: Claus Nielsen — every da term below is a PROPOSAL until marked approved
note: Canonical glossary for all Liviqa surfaces (iOS app, B2B console). The console repo carries a copy at docs/TERMS.json — this file is canonical. Enforced mechanically by TerminologyTests (iOS) and ci-guards [no-advice-voice] (console); enforced interactively by Weblate's glossary once deployed.

locked.note: Never 'alert', 'warning' or 'notification' — a nudge informs, it never alarms.
Spell out on first use; TIR only after.
Never 'permission' in consent contexts — samtykke is the GDPR term.
A share is granted by the citizen; recipients never 'get access', they 'receive a share'.
The citizen app NEVER says 'patient'. Clinician-side surfaces may.
The display-only promise — keep the exact phrase.
Prescription medication lives in Fælles Medicinkort, never in Liviqa.
Personal baseline language — never population norms in citizen copy.

forbiddenVoice.note: Advice-voice is banned in all citizen-facing copy (FR-NDG allow-list: levers say 'could help' / 'may help', never instructions). 'you should know' as an idiom is allowed.
